scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Ronda and White Villages Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

ronda-and-white-villages-route.story: A one-way ride of 156 km, Arcos de la Frontera to Ronda - roughly 2 h 09 in the saddle. On the way it passes Grazalema, Zahara de la Sierra and Setenil de las Bodegas. The highest point is about 850 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
